title: introduce-intake-quality-scorer-and-release-digest-suggester
author: Priya Nair
description:
Context and motivation: New model intake flows lack a lightweight automated signal that estimates whether a freshly uploaded model is likely to be 'release-ready' for serving and what concise release-digest should be suggested for PRs. This PR adds a low-cost intake quality scorer that synthesizes metadata, quick probes (sanity and latency/throughput smoke), and historical-affinity hints into a single priority/quality score, and a companion release-digest-suggester that generates a draft changelog blurb and bullet highlights for the onboarding PR.

Goals: (1) provide a machine-suggested 'priority' and 'quality' metric to help curators triage new model uploads; (2) auto-generate a concise release digest to reduce manual drafting time and improve consistency of release notes; (3) keep runtime and infra costs small (probe budget ~1-3 sample runs) so this can run as part of intake and CI.

What this PR changes (summary): Added intake/quality scorer service (Python) with a pluggable probe runner, lightweight heuristics for metadata completeness, and a small ML-backed ranker trained on historical onboarding decisions. Added changelog/digest suggester that assembles title, 3-line summary, and bullet highlights. Wire-up in intake webhook: new step that attaches suggestion as 'auto_digest' to intake manifest. Added CLI flag (--apply-auto-digest) to onboardctl to optionally apply suggestions to PR templates. Tests: unit tests for heuristics and integration smoke that runs the prober in a local-fast mode.

Checklist:
- [x] Design doc reviewed (linked: ENG-4921)
- [x] Unit + integration tests added
- [x] Backwards-compatible: metadata fields are optional, suggestions are stored in a new optional manifest key
- [x] Feature gated behind 'intake_auto_digest' feature flag
- [x] Telemetry: added metric intake.quality_score_distribution

Commits (high level):
- 6d1f3c5: introduce prober abstraction and smoke probes
- 3a7b92d: implement metadata completeness heuristics
- bb2f11a: add ranker model scaffold and training harness (v0 non-blocking)
- 97f4a22: changelog suggester: templates + prioritization rules
- a1c7b33: wire intake webhook and onboardctl flag
- c9e8d01: add tests and CI workflow for prober

Changed files (high level):
- intake/prober.py (new) -- prober abstraction + basic probes (sanity, sample-latency, sample-output-check)
- intake/quality_scorer.py (new) -- scoring pipeline combining heuristics + ranker
- changelog/suggester.py (new) -- template-driven digest generator
- cli/onboardctl.ts -- new --apply-auto-digest flag and output preview
- webhooks/intake_handler.py -- attach auto_digest to intake manifest (feature-flag gated)
- docs/onboarding/auto-digest.md -- docs for curators + rollout notes
- tests/test_prober.py, tests/test_suggester.py -- unit tests
- .github/workflows/prober-ci.yml -- CI job that runs smoke probes in sandbox

Testing notes: The prober supports a fast-local mode that runs with synthetic inputs and a 'sandbox' runner that uses model caching for isolated runs. CI runs fast-local in PRs; the release pipeline runs full probes when a model is promoted to staging. Tests include mock model endpoints to ensure deterministic results.

Rollout plan: Merge behind feature flag; enable for 10% of uploads for first week to surface false positives/negatives. Expose quality_score and suggested_digest on intake UI (read-only) initially. After 2 weeks, increase to 50% and solicit curator feedback. Optional 'apply' action in onboardctl remains manual until curator sign-off.

Migration notes and backwards compatibility: The change adds a new optional manifest key 'auto_digest' and 'quality_score' (structure: {score, priority, tags}). We documented the key so older components ignore it safely. No schema migration required.

Telemetry and observability: Added metrics intake_quality_score.histogram, intake_auto_digest.generated_count, prober_probe_latency.seconds. Added traces around prober runs; failure modes are recorded to Sentry with sample rate 1% to avoid noise.

Security considerations: Prober runs are sandboxed with timeouts and tokenized ephemeral credentials. Probe payloads are size-limited and sanitized to avoid model injection risks. Training scaffold stores only derived features, not raw prompts.

Related work and follow-ups: This is intentionally minimal; follow-ups include (a) improving ranker with additional training data (ENG-4978), (b) richer release templates for enterprise customers, (c) integration with release-note automation to push accepted digests into release drafts when curator confirms.

release_notes: Add intake quality scorer and auto-generated release digest for onboarding PRs. Feature gated and opt-in via onboardctl. Improves curator triage velocity and reduces manual changelog drafting.
